headline: Co-founder of Totally.Digital. Always working in the gap {between} strategy and shipping.
intro: SEO and all things Search since 2012; ten years inside a software development company has taught me the hard part is never the idea. It’s all the teams who need to agree, the data nobody trusts, and then the change nobody owns, which somehow always ends up on me. That is the middle where I work.
I am technical enough to read the code and the logs, commercial enough to sell the priority to a board, make the trade-offs that matter, get the thing over the line, and measure whether it worked.
